note: The Terrain survey record, machine-readable (SPEC.md beside this file
is the prose half; kogaki#14 umbrella, kogaki#17 story 1.8, manifest
item 1). checks/check-terrain-composition.sh READS these lists rather
than restating them — this file is the single carrier, so amending the
contract is one edit and never a two-copy divergence. Same arrangement
as record-schema.json (item 3) and gate-schema.json (item 4).
The three contracts bound here are SPEC.md §2.1–§2.3: completeness is
a cover counted in placements, grouping is presentation-only, and the
second-proposer boundary keeps narrowing out of navigation state.
v2 (kogaki#26/#27, story 1.22) carries SPEC.md §5's candidate model and
§9's family-named figures: candidate rows are LESSONS ONLY, the Journey
family is a per-Lesson MARK read by absence, `journeys` carries the
served Journey set so count-in stays computable against count-out, and
`section_required` gains `by_family` — the fill of
`deferred-slot: terrain-family-split-carrier` with alternative (a), the
per-section family split living in the RECORD (owner decision
The single-carrier clause covers these FIELD LISTS. It does NOT cover
the recompute ALGORITHM, which is written twice on purpose —
src/terrain.mjs (generation-time refusal) and
check-terrain-composition.sh (merge-layer detection). SPEC.md §9
records that correction; collapsing the duplication is not licensed.
candidate_family_rationale: a candidate row is ONE Lesson and a Journey is a MARK on its Lesson's row, never a row of its own (SPEC.md §5); a journey-family candidate is the two-family row model arriving back as data

survey.candidate_display_id_rationale: SPEC.md §14.3 — no owner surface renders an element name; the rendered token is `display_id`, assigned ONCE here in the survey record, which IS the ID→slug map. It is required rather than optional because an optional identifier has a fallback, and the only fallback available is the ~40-character slug the decision removed — so the field's absence must be an ABNORMAL condition a surface states, never a shape a surface silently accommodates. Uniqueness is checked within the record: two members sharing a display_id makes the join return the wrong Strand, which reads as a rename rather than as a collision
survey.narrowing_rationale: sections gate nothing and a navigation step carries no selection authority (SPEC.md §2.2); a narrowing key in navigation state is the refused minimal-form bundling arriving as a field
survey.journey_mark_rationale: the mark reads by ABSENCE — a Lesson with no Journey is decorated, a Lesson with one is not (SPEC.md §5); the key is present on every candidate, null when the Lesson is thin
survey.journeys_rationale: the served Journey set, carried so count-in stays computable against count-out: Lessons plus marks reconstructs the Strand set exactly, and a Journey whose slug matches no Lesson has no row to be marked on (SPEC.md §5.2, falsifier 1)
survey.orphan_journey_rationale: falsifier 1 — a Journey whose slug matches no Lesson candidate is silently dropped by the re-projection, so the survey is REFUSED at generation time and the orphan slugs are named; §2.1 forbids the silent drop and a rendering-time warning is not the carrier

section.by_family_rationale: the per-section family split lives in the RECORD (deferred-slot terrain-family-split-carrier, alternative (a), owner decision 2026-08-06, SPEC.md §9): placements are authoritative, the stored section figure is subordinate, and FIGURE_MISMATCH is the mechanical check — the same shape completeness.by_family already has, at the layer the figure is created
section.counted: lesson = member Lessons; journey = member Lessons carrying a Journey mark. The rendered section figure is their sum, which is the Strand count `agents (115 — 59 lessons + 56 journeys)` §9 names, never a bare 115

completeness.counted_over_rationale: the count runs AFTER composition; a figure computed over the candidate set reads as a pass while material is missing (SPEC.md §2.1)
completeness.family_rationale: every figure names which family it counted — a bare count is a defect, not a terse rendering (SPEC.md §2.1; GLOSSARY.md:248@924cce3)
completeness.denominator_rationale: `placed` and `of` are counted IN LESSONS — every screen showing candidate rows states its denominator in Lessons (SPEC.md §5); the load-bearing half of the design is the denominator rather than the mark, because it is what makes the next coverage inversion visible on-screen. `by_family` beside it carries the Strand split, so the figure names its families without the denominator drifting off Lessons
completeness.coverage_rationale: the coverage figure (thin Lessons / Lessons) rides beside the mark; falsifier 2's reversal trigger is coverage >= 99%, and SPEC.md §5.2 declares `instrument: none` for it — it is printed, never read by a check, and this schema does not supply the carrier that section deliberately withholds

group_claim.note: SPEC.md §7 — a claim composed over a member set is PINNED to that set. The record carries the member IDS, not only the claim text, because a derived expression's truth is relative to the set it was derived from.
group_claim.composed_over_rationale: the claim is composed over the MEMBERS, so a change to the member set is a GATE EVENT rather than a refresh (SPEC.md §7)
group_claim.adopted_rationale: a group-claim record is a per-invocation RENDERING and is never itself the adopted claim; adoption is the owner's act at the gate and lands in an adopted-claim record
group_claim.narrowing_rationale: composing a claim over a group is PRESENTATION and narrows nothing on its own; a subset selection is the OWNER's act, and rank/trim/hide still route through the proposal contract (SPEC.md §2.3, §8.2)

adopted_claim.note: SPEC.md §7 — the brief records the adopted claim TOGETHER WITH the members it was composed from, by member id and pin, never by a group id.
adopted_claim.claim_source_rationale: the recomposed claim is a PROPOSAL: the owner may keep the original wording, and the recorded member set is what makes the resulting mismatch LEGIBLE rather than forbidden (SPEC.md §7)
adopted_claim.group_id_rationale: recorded by member id and pin and NEVER by a group id — a group id lets the member set change underneath the claim without the record moving, which is the provenance lie §7 refuses
adopted_claim.gate_rationale: adoption happens only at the gate carrier (manifest item 4): the recomposed claim is re-offered as a GATE EVENT, never a silent refresh, so an adopted claim with no gate row was never offered

subdivision.note: SPEC.md §8 — semantic subdivision as a judged substrate one level down. Placement plus title-derivation, hiding none: a cap decides WHICH members appear, subdivision decides WHERE each appears and hides none, so it is inside the presentation-only invariant and is not the refused within-axis cap.
subdivision.judge_rationale: the fourth component on the existing pin discipline, ADOPTED for per-invocation judged surfaces and naming terrain screens, claims and groupings among them (topics/knowledge-architecture.md:84@f918c515). Where drift is undetectable, pin: a surface regenerated fresh by design lets `recomputed fresh` silently become `recomputed by a different judge` with nothing in the record distinguishing that from ordinary nondeterminism. The pin makes a judge change OBSERVABLE and the judge-migration tripwire (:85) makes it CONSEQUENTIAL; either alone leaves the loop open. WHICH model is therefore a per-invocation PINNED FACT, not a design decision this schema fixes — and this repository fixes none.
subdivision.no_member_hidden_retired: RETIRED at kogaki#738 (owner rulings 2026-09-01). This block declared `no_member_hidden_subgroup: "(fits no composed SubGroup)"` and the rationale "every member of the parent group appears in at least one SubGroup, and members that fit none appear in an EXPLICIT NAMED SubGroup rather than being dropped". The COVER PROPERTY is untouched and is stronger now: every member still appears, and it appears because the JUDGE placed it. What is gone is the engine-composed SubGroup that held whatever the judge left over — a classification leaving any member unplaced is now REFUSED, naming the members (SPEC.md §6.2 rule 1), so there is no leftover for a named bucket to hold. The name is retired rather than kept unused: a declared name nothing composes is a name a later reader will compose against.

meanings.related: members share a theme, not one mechanism
meanings.loose: an affinity weaker than a shared theme, and still a real one
meanings.other: THE RESIDUAL, not a fourth affinity: the members the judge could place nowhere. Assigning members here asserts the judge found no subset of `limits.min_subgroup_members` or more at loose-or-better affinity among them.

coherence.residual_is_not_an_affinity: `other` carries no per-label cap in report-format.json's limits.subgroup_member_cap and is not bound by min_subgroup_members; it is bounded by max_residual_members instead. Three labels assert a relationship; the fourth asserts the absence of one, and giving it a cap row would let a reader treat it as a fourth affinity (kogaki#738 owner amendment 2, 2026-09-01).
coherence.third_label_supersession: `forced` ("grouped to satisfy the split requirement") until kogaki#738, owner rulings 2026-09-01. It named a fact about the ENGINE rather than about the members, and the placement's unplaced-members sweep could stamp it with no judgment behind it at all. Owner amendments 1 and 2 the same day then adopted `loose` as the third AFFINITY label and re-read `other` as the residual. The body's "`other` needs no share cap because it is judged" is SUPERSEDED — `other` = unlimited is an anti-pattern — and the residual carries `max_residual_members` instead (SPEC.md §8).
coherence._retired_vocab_ok: retired-vocab-ok (kogaki#708): the retired terms quoted in the next value are there to say what the coherence label REPLACED, never as current contract.
coherence.rationale: ONE INSTRUMENT, NOT TWO (kogaki#683 disposition 5, owner selection at pickup 2026-08-29). This REPLACES the conjunctive leaf condition — `composes_honestly` and `tighter_than_parent` are removed, not kept beside it. The label carries what the conjuncts carried and one thing they could not: `tight` is what the conjunction admitted, `related` is the honest-but-not-tighter middle the conjunction collapsed into a bare failure, and `loose` is the weakest affinity that is still one. THE THIRD SLOT USED TO READ DIFFERENTLY: `forced` named the split the 10-member requirement compelled — a fact about the ENGINE — and kogaki#738 replaced it, first with `other` and then, at owner amendment 2, with `loose` as the third AFFINITY and `other` re-read as the RESIDUAL. The residual is not a fourth affinity and asserts the absence of one; see `residual_is_not_an_affinity`. The judge selects exactly one and supplies one free-form sentence of why; both render under the claim.
coherence.never_defaulted: A record arriving with no label, or with a value outside the closed set, is REFUSED at `judgeSubgroup` rather than defaulted — a default would be the engine supplying the judgment the label exists to carry. A label with no `coherence_why` is refused for the same reason: the two are one instrument.
coherence.values_are_consumer_owned: A consumer owns the SHAPE of its own record and never the VALUES of a field that JOINS across a boundary. This label is rendered on kogaki's own screen and read by nothing outside it, so the values are minted here. consulted: product-lab@b20d85ea9c2a6ba24542e7caa003ef42efce33b2 topics/knowledge-architecture.md:198

disclosures.rationale: the degenerate-claim disclosure fires when a claim trails into enumeration; it does NOT detect the reported condition on its own, which is why the second exists — the claim is honest but UNDISCRIMINATING at the size served, and an honest summary true of every member discriminates between none (topics/articles.md:67@f918c515). They are evaluated independently and neither gates the other.
degenerate_signals: the claim text naming a member's slug — a claim that names its members is enumerating them, a unit-matching signal carrying no numeric constant
undiscriminating_signals: the claim being textually identical to its parent's, which is undiscriminating by construction

instruments.rationale: THREE INSTRUMENTS, THREE QUANTITIES, NONE A THRESHOLD — 20% of placements (relative share), the screen budget (rendering destination), and at-a-glance legibility (absolute). None of the three gates anything and none is a count of members; that is unchanged at v30. The threshold the engine carries (SUBDIVISION_REQUIRED_AT, kogaki#683) is not one of these and did not become one: it decides WHETHER a group must split, while these three are reported quantities about a split that happened. The owner's `above ~4 members` remains CALIBRATION EVIDENCE for where the undiscriminating-claim condition binds and was never the boundary (topics/articles.md:68@f918c515).
instruments._retired_vocab_ok: retired-vocab-ok (kogaki#708): the retired term quoted in the next value names what disposition 5 REPLACED, never current contract.
instruments.no_member_count_threshold: THE SPLIT DECISION IS THE ENGINE'S, AND THE THRESHOLD IS 10 (kogaki#683, owner ruling 2026-08-28 reversing the 2026-08-09 kogaki#316 withdrawal). A composed group at or above 10 members must serve SubGroups; a judged-empty outcome for such a group is refused at render. The three instruments here are UNCHANGED and still gate nothing — they remain REPORTED quantities, and the threshold is not one of them: it decides WHETHER TO SPLIT, which is now the engine's, while membership assignment stays the judge's. `legible_at_a_glance` in particular is untouched by disposition 5's reconciliation, which replaced the leaf condition and deliberately left this triple whole.
instruments.carrier_state: The prohibition this field used to declare carrier-less is GONE — the owner reversed it. What IS carried: `subdivision_required_at_ten` in report-format.json refuses the rendered violation on the co-tag screen, `cmdReport` refuses a judged-empty group at the threshold before rendering the Full Report, and the runtime declines to suppress a split at or above the threshold so the refusable screen is not produced. The three instruments remain reported and ungated, which is unchanged and deliberate.

subdivision.offering_rationale: SPEC.md §8.1 — subdivision ships DOGFOOD-FIRST: implemented → dogfooded → owner-verdicted → offered. Co-tags stay the default for a run naming no substrate, and subdivision is reachable only by explicitly naming it. Merging this code ARRIVES at the offering gate rather than discharging it: merged code evidences existence, never the gate's standing (topics/articles.md:53@f918c515). The hub-side gate at product-lab:q_a/staging/2026-07-31-subdivision-offering-measurement-due.md is undischarged and this record does not discharge it.

records_home.rationale: a default carrier, not an enumerated directory — an enumerated home leaves record N+1 uncovered by default; real runs live in the machine-local run workspace and are never committed (specs/SPEC.md §4 rider 3)
